response.justification: Bogdan has broad engineering experience across languages and domains, including Java and JVM-related work in past roles, but lacks clear, recent, or deep focus on enterprise Java/Kotlin tooling, Spring, or IDE internals — his recent work is dominated by TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with no explicit mention of IDE development, JVM tooling, or enterprise framework integration.
strengths: Proven experience with Java in past roles (e.g., National Instruments, Altom Consulting)
Strong track record in developer tooling and open-source contributions (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Excellent communication and teaching skills demonstrated through workshops and talks
concerns: Recent work is primarily in TypeScript/Node.js/DLang with no clear enterprise JVM focus
No evidence of IDE internals, language server protocol, or build tool integration experience
Limited recent exposure to Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or application server tooling
